crime_highlights: Mr. Robert withdrew, flipped C.O. over, pinned her down
He continued for about a minute without her consent until she broke free
C.O. suffered a bruised arm, swollen elbow, and scratched back in the assault
The injuries establish that the assault was violent
rationale_highlights: Mr. Robert's moral blameworthiness is mitigated to some degree by the awful circumstances of his upbringing
He is in part a product of the conditions in which he was raised which included poverty, physical abuse, and substance abuse
Mr. Robert's background and upbringing reduce his moral culpability
Mr. Robert's background and upbringing support a more lenient sentence and a greater emphasis on rehabilitation than would otherwise be appropriate
note: Crime narrative short; graphic sexual detail not highlighted.

crime_highlights: police officers made observations consistent with Mr. Campbell selling drugs to end users and supplying street-level traffickers
627.5 grams of fentanyl divided into 665 baggies or bags
846.42 grams of cocaine divided into 503 baggies or bags
rationale_highlights: Mr. Campbell's father was physically abusive to his wife and children
This negative and corrosive influence has replicated itself in Mr. Campbell's own addiction issues
Mr. Campbell's difficult upbringing and the significant likelihood that intergenerational trauma encompassed by the Gladue considerations had a role to play in Mr. Campbell being before the Court
his upbringing no doubt contributing to his own addiction issues
note: Drug case, no victim harm; effect stated as mitigating factor in para 81.

crime_highlights: Mr. Gladue killed Ms. West in her own home where she should have felt secure and safe
The killing was an act of extreme violence, as is reflected by the at least 33 stab wounds to Ms. West's body
some of which were found by the pathologist to have likely been inflicted during Ms. West's defensive manoeuvres
After killing Ms. West, Mr. Gladue covered her body with a blanket
Her body was not discovered for six days
rationale_highlights: It details Mr. Gladue's difficult personal history and family relationships, including his heavy consumption of alcohol and drugs since age 14
Mr. Gladue is an Indigenous man whose background of early substance abuse is all too prevalent in the Indigenous persons coming before the courts
note: Court lists Indigenous background as mitigating but never states its effect on culpability.
